fields.description: Seef Residences places apartment living on Sharjah’s Al Khan waterfront, where the lagoon meets the open coast. Five residential buildings combine homes with a beachside promenade, landscaped spaces and everyday places to gather.

overview: The developer’s launch programme covers 862 residences across five buildings, including apartments and limited penthouses. This is the planned development scale, rather than a statement of available stock.
Published B3 and B4 documents show different layouts, including garden apartments and duplexes. The detailed schedule below covers those two buildings only.
research.locationNote: The developer places Seef on Al Khan’s coast, alongside Al Mamzar Lake, Al Khan Lagoon and the Arabian Gulf. Nearby water bodies do not change the project’s stated Al Khan address.
research.priceNote: The developer advertises AED 895,000. Its 21 October 2026 launch release lists one-, two- and three-bedroom starting prices of AED 895,000, AED 1,295,000 and AED 2,195,000 respectively. These are launch guides; obtain a dated quotation for an available home.
research.paymentNote: The developer publishes 30 / 70. The breakdown below is an attributed broker reference dated 26 October 2026; an original dated developer instalment schedule was not retrieved.
research.handoverNote: The developer’s launch release targets 30 September 2030. Property Finder instead lists June 2030 and misattributes the project to Aldar; its ownership and earlier date are not adopted. Completion remains a forecast.
